name: slack-threads
title: Slack threads
description: Slack as project code: a project chat per Slack thread that answers mentions and posts its replies back, reading and searching Slack through the gateway.
docs:
Install into a project on a Work server where Slack is connected; the Work server guide's "Connect Slack" covers the server side (the Slack app, its gateway entry, and the `slack` and `slack-search` service connections).

1. Copy the files to their targets, merging rather than overwriting: add the manifest's `slack` and `slackSearch` bindings to the Environments that should reach Slack in the project's `.work/project.json`, and leave `slackSearch` out until a search token is set up.
2. Link Slack users to project members in `SLACK_MEMBERS` in `.work/workflows/src/slack-threads.ts`, or leave it empty; a link names the person, it never lends their access.
3. Check the project (`program_check`) and deploy, then enable `answerSlackMentions` and `postSlackReplies` for the project with the `slack` connection consented. The `slack` webhook answers only once they are on: save its URL as the Slack app's Request URL after that, and invite the app to each channel (`/invite @app`).

The installed `.work/skills/slack/SKILL.md` stays with the project and explains each file and how to read and cite Slack.
